messages:
Priya: Heads-up: I noticed several broken internal links after the recent optimize-toolkit doc split. Examples in prefetch and batching pages 404. Can someone spare 15m to sweep?
Diego: I can take the anchor fixes. Which files are 404ing?
Priya: Found these paths: `optimize/kv.md` (old anchor #kv-cache-prefetch), `optimize/batching.md` (old anchor #short-batch). The anchors were renamed during the restructure to `#kv-prefetch` and `#small-batch`.
Rae: Also the SDK snippet in `examples/python/quick_batch.py` still shows `prefetch=True`. That mismatch will confuse users.
Diego: I'll update anchors and put a redirect note in the prefetch doc. Quick plan: 1) replace broken anchors across docs 2) update examples to use `kv_prefetch` 3) add a one-line migration note under `docs/migration/1.4-to-1.5.md`
Priya: Sounds good. Can you check samplegen tests too? We had a flake earlier when snippet names changed.
ci-bot: ci/docs  link-checker found 3 broken anchors  https://ci.redwood/checks/8821
Diego: Picking this up now. Will open a docs-only PR for anchor fixes + snippet edits.
Rae: FYI the python example also has an outdated import path: `from redwood.sdk import Client` -> `from redwood.client import RedwoodClient`. I can do that cleanup in the same pass.
Priya: Great catch. Please include that in the PR description so reviewers notice the combined change.
Diego: Draft PR #840: docs(anchor-fix): normalize kv-prefetch anchors, update python snippet imports, and add migration note. Preview link: https://staging.docs.redwood/pr/840
ci-bot: docs/#840  preview deployed to staging  https://staging.docs.redwood/pr/840
Rae: Spun up a quick venv and ran the example. After changing import + param name it runs locally.
Priya: Can someone run the samplegen unit tests before we merge? I want to avoid a duplicate break in the release window.
Diego: Running locally now.
ci-bot: ci/samplegen  queued (run id: 993)
Diego: Local run shows one flaky assertion in `test_batch_scheduler` unrelated to docs. Looks like timing noise. I'll re-run CI after merging docs.
Priya: If samplegen CI is flaky, let's not block docs. Add a note in the PR describing the flaky test and that it's unrelated to the doc-only change.
Diego: Added note and a link to the flaky test ticket #452.
ci-bot: docs/#840  checks passed  link-checker clean
Taylor: LGTM on content. Small nit: bump the migration note to the top of the page so its more visible.
Diego: Moved the migration note to the top of `migration/1.4-to-1.5.md`.
ci-bot: docs/#840  merged by Diego  commit ab12cd34
Priya: Thanks! Can someone drop a short message in #release-war-room so PMs know anchors changed? Some embedding links in customer guides point to the old anchors.
Taylor: I'll post a short note and include the changelog link.
Rae: One follow-up: we should add a unit in the docs CI that runs the snippet examples to catch param/import mismatches earlier. Filing a small infra task.
Priya: Filed infra task #778 (docs-snippet-smoke) and linked it in the PR. Good catch Rae.
ci-bot: monitor  next docs link-check scheduled in 6h
Diego: Closing local branch. If anything else crops up ping me.
Priya: Thanks team  saved a few support tickets.
